prerequisites: A consumer/provider contract (pact file) or a running provider under test
Broker access only when the claim explicitly requires publishing/verifying against a broker
rollback: Do not publish contract results unless the claim requires it
Discard local verification artifacts; stop the ad-hoc provider instance

hosts.notes: Provider verification is a live receipt; a missing pact CLI yields UNAVAILABLE evidence.

notes: Contract verification evidence proves the consumer/provider contract, not the whole product.
Never inferred from schema files alone; a claim must actually name contract verification.
